parts:
Hi=20Gyermund,

Thanks=20for=20sending=20me=20your=20project=20file=20(off=20the=20list).=20=
=20The=20error=20is=20caused=20by=20
a=20bug=20in=20the=20design=20properties=20pages,=20that=20means=20it=20is=
=20appling=20the=20wrong=20
projection=20to=20your=20data.=20=20

The=20easiest=20solution=20is=20also=20a=20good=20general=20rule=20for=20a=
nyone=20who=20is=20doing=20survey=20
design=20using=20shapefiles=20that=20have=20already=20been=20projected=20(=
i.e.,=20where=20the=20units=20
are=20linear=20units=20such=20as=20meters)=20as=20opposed=20to=20shapefiil=
es=20that=20are=20not=20
projected=20(i.e.,=20where=20the=20units=20are=20angular=20units=20such=20=
as=20degrees=20of=20latitude=20
and=20longitude).=20=20The=20rule=20is=20to=20import=20your=20shapefiles=20=
into=20distance=20without=20the=20
coordinate=20system=20--=20in=20other=20words=20as=20non-earth=20reference=
d.=20=20You=20do=20this=20by=20not=20
copying=20the=20.prj=20(projection)=20files=20into=20the=20distance=20data=
=20directory=20when=20you=20
are=20copying=20the=20other=20shapefiles=20there.=20=20Then,=20in=20Distan=
ce,=20under=20File=20|=20Project=20
Properties,=20Geographic,=20set=20the=20coordinate=20system=20and=20projec=
tion=20to=20None,=20and=20
the=20units=20to=20whatever=20units=20your=20shapefile=20was=20projected=20=
in=20(e.g.,=20meters).

The=20design=20engine=20will=20then=20proceed=20to=20work=20with=20the=20g=
eographic=20data=20in=20the=20
correct=20units=20(e.g.,=20meters),=20but=20will=20not=20do=20any=20projec=
ting=20--=20which=20is=20fine=20
since=20you've=20done=20it=20already.=20=20This=20saves=20computer=20time=20=
when=20doing=20computer-
intensive=20things=20such=20as=20coverage=20probability=20simulations.

Hope=20this=20makes=20sense=20--=20I'll=20make=20sure=20there's=20somethin=
g=20to=20this=20effect=20in=20the=20
manual=20in=20future.

Also,=20I=20notice=20in=20your=20project=20you=20have=20a=20global=20layer=
,=20and=20also=20a=20stratum=20layer=20
that=20has=20only=20one=20polygon=20that=20is=20the=20same=20as=20the=20gl=
obal=20layer=20polygon.=20=20You=20
don't=20need=20the=20stratum=20layer=20in=20this=20case=20--=20you=20can=20=
do=20the=20design=20with=20the=20
Design=20Properties=20|=20General=20tab,=20"Stratum=20layer"=20setting=20s=
et=20to=20the=20name=20of=20your=20
global=20layer.=20=20I=20think=20the=20"Stratum=20layer"=20label=20in=20th=
is=20case=20is=20a=20bit=20
confusing,=20so=20I'll=20change=20it=20for=20the=20next=20release=20of=20D=
istance=20and=20add=20some=20
clarification=20to=20the=20manual.

Hope=20this=20helps,

=20-=20Len
